added: 新增地图站：导航栏新增「地图站」页签，顶部提供种子输入框、游戏版本下拉与地图类型下拉（群系地图 / 史莱姆区块 / 要塞结构），主体以 iframe 直接内嵌第三方种子地图站点，全程不经过主站后端，无后端依赖
地图站提供【在浏览器中打开】兜底入口；因第三方站点可能以 X-Frame-Options 拒绝内嵌，采用加载超时检测并在失败时给出明确提示
开服中心新增本地开服：创建服务器时下拉选择服务端核心（Vanilla / Paper / Fabric / Forge / NeoForge）与对应游戏版本，由启动器直接向上游下载服务端核心并落盘到本地服务器目录，自动预建 mods / config / world 等目录并写入 eula.txt 与 server.properties
improved: 「生成客户端清单」界面重构为客户端清单工作室：分栏卡片布局，顶部显示服务器名称与目录，左侧为大尺寸【重新扫描目录】按钮与上次扫描时间，右侧按 mods / config 分组展示文件并支持逐个勾选剔除不需要同步给玩家的文件
生成客户端清单时同时产出 manifest.json 与打包好的客户端 ZIP 包，并给出「上传 ZIP 获取直链 → 填入 manifest.json → 把 JSON 地址发给玩家」的完整引导
方块广场「第三方服务器列表」改为「客户端同步大厅」：保留添加条目表单与启动并同步进服能力，移除在线人数、服务器图标、第三方状态查询与热门标签等联网展示
fixed: 全局修复表单控件的系统白底问题：输入框、文本域、下拉框、复选框与单选框统一覆盖为深色半透明背景与浅色文字，复选框与单选框改为完全自绘并使用主题色，focus 边框高亮为主题色并去除浏览器默认蓝色发光圈

added: Added the Map Station: a new tab in the navigation bar with a seed input, a game version dropdown and a map type dropdown (Biome Map / Slime Chunks / Strongholds); the main area embeds the third-party seed map site directly in an iframe, never through the site backend and with no backend dependency
The Map Station provides an Open in Browser fallback; since the third-party site may reject embedding with X-Frame-Options, a load timeout check surfaces a clear notice when embedding fails

Added Local Hosting to the Hosting Center: when creating a server, pick a server core (Vanilla / Paper / Fabric / Forge / NeoForge) plus a matching game version; the launcher downloads the server core straight from upstream into a local server directory and pre-creates mods / config / world (plus plugins for Paper) along with eula.txt and server.properties
improved: The Generate Client Manifest UI was rebuilt into the Client Manifest Studio: a split-card layout with the server name and directory on top, an oversized Rescan Directory button with the last scan time on the left, and a right-hand file area grouped by mods / config where each file can be ticked off to exclude it from the player sync

Generating a client manifest now produces both manifest.json and a packaged client ZIP, together with a full guide: upload the ZIP for a direct link, fill it into manifest.json, then send the JSON address to your players

The Block Plaza server list became the Client Sync Hall: the add-entry form and launch-and-sync flow stay, while online player counts, server icons, third-party status lookups and hot tags are removed
fixed: Fixed the glaring white system background on form controls across the whole UI: inputs, textareas, selects, checkboxes and radios now use a dark translucent background with light text, checkboxes and radios are fully custom-drawn with the theme accent, and focus highlights the border with the theme color instead of the browser's default blue glow

added: 全局中英双语国际化：启动器全面接入 next-intl，界面文案不再有硬编码中文或英文残留
设置 → 通用 新增【语言切换】（简体中文 / English），切换后整个界面实时无刷新切换，语言选择本地持久化
联机大厅重构为完整开服闭环：与「视界」深度绑定，打通「开服 → 邀请 → 进服」
房主模式：选定视界后创建联机房间，生成 6 位房间码并支持一键复制，提供【启动游戏并开服】与图文引导，填写端口（默认 25565）后绑定等待加入
好友模式：输入 6 位房间码加入房间，成功后可一键启动游戏，并在多人游戏中刷新出房主的局域网世界
improved: 联机大厅所有文字支持中英双语，保持极简磨砂玻璃质感
底层联机：主站在线时经主站 WebSocket 注册房间，主站离线时降级到 EasyTier 公共节点打洞，并转发 UDP 局域网广播包

added: Full Chinese/English internationalization: the launcher now uses next-intl throughout, with no hardcoded Chinese or English text left in the UI
A new Language switch (Simplified Chinese / English) in Settings > General switches the entire UI instantly with no reload, and the choice is persisted locally
The Peer Lobby was rebuilt into a complete hosting loop bound to Horizons, covering host -> invite -> join

Host mode: create a room after selecting a Horizon, get a 6-digit room code with one-click copy, use Launch game & host with an illustrated guide, then bind the port (default 25565) and wait for friends
Friend mode: join with a 6-digit room code, then launch the game with one click and the host's LAN world appears under Multiplayer
improved: All Peer Lobby text is now bilingual, keeping the minimal frosted-glass look
Underlying transport: rooms register over the community WebSocket while it is online and fall back to EasyTier public relays with hole punching, forwarding UDP LAN broadcast packets

added: 新增联机大厅（P2P）：支持创建房间（生成 6 位房间码，可一键复制）与加入房间，优先接入主站高速联机节点，不可用时自动降级到公共联机节点（EasyTier / 公共 STUN-TURN）
服务器大厅内置 Hypixel、2b2t 等主流服务器，卡片提供一键进服与访问官网入口
关于页面新增鸣谢区、开发团队区与版权声明区，支持中英双语切换
improved: 服务器大厅按在线人数降序排列，大服自动置顶并标记「热门」，新增「刷新状态」按钮批量更新全部服务器状态
首页欢迎词「欢迎回来，[用户名]」采用中文艺术字体，用户名采用英文签名艺术字体
首页「启动游戏」按钮移至右下角，右侧账号面板按正版账号在上、离线账号在下排列（最多 5 个）
fixed: 移除服务器大厅页面内重复的大标题，仅保留侧边栏导航入口
联机大厅在无主站节点可用时不再抛错，而是自动降级到公共联机节点并给出可读说明

added: Added the Peer Lobby (P2P): create a room (6-digit room code with one-click copy) or join a room; it prefers the official high-speed relay and automatically falls back to public relays (EasyTier / public STUN-TURN) when unavailable
The server lobby now ships built-in mainstream servers such as Hypixel and 2b2t, with one-click join and website shortcuts on each card
The About page now includes a credits section, a development team section, and a copyright section with a Chinese/English toggle
improved: The server lobby now sorts servers by online player count in descending order, pins large servers to the top with a "Hot" tag, and adds a Refresh Status button for batch status updates
The home greeting "Welcome back, [name]" now uses an artistic Chinese font and the username uses a handwritten English signature font
The Start Game button on the home page moved to the bottom right; the account panel now lists Mojang accounts first and offline accounts below (up to 5)
fixed: Removed the duplicated large heading inside the server lobby page, keeping only the sidebar navigation entry
The Peer Lobby no longer throws when no official relay is reachable; it falls back to a public relay with a readable notice

improved: 资源中心第二步详情面板改为满高填充，版本演进图与详情面板纵向随窗口拉伸铺满
fixed: 修复资源中心全屏自适应：废除外层固定的 max-width 限制，改用 width 100% 的 Flex 布局，左侧版本演进图与右侧详情面板按约 1.8 : 1 的比例随窗口放大拉伸，消除两侧大片留白
修复版本演进图轨道高度被固定为 420px 的问题，改为占满面板剩余高度（最小 240px）

improved: The step-2 detail panel in the Resource Center now fills the available height, letting the version graph and the detail panel stretch vertically
fixed: Fixed the Resource Center full-screen layout: removed the fixed outer max-width and switched to a width:100% flex layout, so the version graph on the left and the detail panel on the right scale proportionally (about 1.8 : 1) with the window and the large side gaps are gone
Fixed the version graph track being locked to a 420px height; it now fills the remaining panel height (min 240px)

added: 皮肤库内置 100 款精选皮肤，支持「精选 / 全部」浏览、分页（每页 15 款）、懒加载与换页防抖
资源中心第三步支持为 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge 自由选择具体的加载器版本，不再强制使用最新版
版本演进图重做为线性时间轴：一条主线贯穿原版正式版，快照版与特殊版自主线节点引出分支
improved: 主界面全屏铺满，顶部导航磨砂质感加深（backdrop-filter blur 26px）
演进图等独立滚动区锁定滚动链，滚轮不再带动整页滚动

added: The skin library now ships 100 built-in skins with Featured / All browsing, paging (15 per page), lazy loading and debounced page changes
Step 3 of the Resource Center now lets you pick a specific version for Fabric / Forge / NeoForge instead of forcing the latest
The version graph is now a linear timeline: a main line runs through releases, with snapshots and special versions branching off the main-line nodes
improved: The main UI now fills the whole window and the top navigation has a deeper frosted look (backdrop-filter blur 26px)
Independent scroll areas such as the graph now lock the scroll chain, so the wheel no longer scrolls the whole page

added: 首页新增启动实例选择下拉框，可直接在开始游戏前切换实例
关系网新增节点预览卡片：悬停或点击节点可查看名称、类型、简介、下载量与兼容版本，支持一键设为中心或跳转资源详情
improved: 顶栏移除深浅色与语言切换按钮，主题、语言、Java、关于统一收归设置页四个子标签管理
关系网连线改为二次贝塞尔曲线并在连线中点标注兼容 / 派生关系，相邻边随选中节点高亮
主题预设统一为 8 套（跟随系统、浅色、深色、OLED、素雅、古典黑、复古、现代）
fixed: 修复背景图下玻璃态面板层叠与模糊效果，面板统一半透明底色与 12px 背景模糊
修复社区头像显示，已登录时直接渲染社区真实头像
修复预发布版本（如 26.3-rc-1）未归入同族导致关系网缺少兼容 / 派生连线的问题
修复资源中心下载模组 / 光影 / 材质包时点击下载导致启动器整个进程退出的问题：原生下载核心改为可移植构建（不再依赖构建机 CPU 指令集），进度获取改为轮询，不再从原生线程跨线程回调界面层

added: Added an instance picker above the Start Game button to switch instances directly
Added node preview cards to the relation graph: hover or click a node for name, type, summary, downloads and compatible versions, with set-as-center and open-detail actions
improved: Removed theme and language toggles from the top bar; theme, language, Java and About are now managed under four tabs in Settings
Relation graph edges are now quadratic bezier curves with compatible/derived labels at the midpoint, and adjacent edges highlight with the selected node
Theme presets consolidated to 8 (system, light, dark, OLED, elegant, classic dark, retro, modern)
fixed: Fixed glassmorphism layering and blur over background images; panels now use unified translucent colors with a 12px backdrop blur
Fixed community avatar rendering to show the real community avatar when signed in
Fixed pre-release versions (e.g. 26.3-rc-1) not being grouped into their family, which removed compatible/derived edges from the relation graph

Fixed the whole launcher process exiting when starting a mod / shader / resource pack download from the Resource Center: the native download core now builds portably (no longer tied to the build machine CPU features), and progress is polled instead of being pushed from the native thread into the UI thread

added: 新增外观与主题系统：极简白、暗夜黑、星图蓝、极光绿、落日橙五套预设主题，支持自定义主色实时预览
新增自定义背景图（JPG / PNG / WebP，5MB 以内）与背景模糊强度调节
首页新增「开始游戏」按钮、累计使用时长与右侧账户面板（社区账号 / 正版账号 / 离线账户最多 6 个）
新增资源中心：下载中心与资源库合并为统一入口，新增树状关系图（兼容 / 依赖 / 衍生关系，支持缩放与拖拽）
官网下载页新增历史版本管理，展示版本号、发布日期、更新类型与新增 / 优化 / 修复内容
improved: 窗口标题改为完整名称 iGM CraftCeon Launcher 并采用品牌艺术字体，窗口图标与官网 LOGO 统一
进入首页时左侧导航自动折叠为图标模式，留出更多展示空间
正版账号登录获取设备码后自动打开默认浏览器完成授权
Java 管理、语言设置、明暗模式统一移入设置页；外观独立为一级菜单
fixed: 修复正版认证过期的历史进度仍显示、造成用户困惑的问题
修复认证失败时错误原因不明确的问题，错误码与原因支持中英双语

added: Added the appearance and theme system: five presets (Minimal White, Night Black, Star Blue, Aurora Green, Sunset Orange) with live custom accent color preview
Added custom background image (JPG / PNG / WebP up to 5MB) with adjustable background blur
Added a Start Game button, cumulative usage hours, and a right-side account panel on the home page (community account / Mojang account / up to 6 offline accounts)
Added the Resource Center: downloads and library merged into one entry, with a tree relationship graph (compatible / dependency / derived, zoom and drag supported)
Added release history on the download site: version, release date, update type, and added / improved / fixed notes
improved: Window title changed to the full name iGM CraftCeon Launcher with the brand display font; window icon unified with the official logo
The sidebar auto-collapses to icon mode on the home page to free up space
Mojang sign-in now opens the default browser automatically after the device code is issued
Java management, language, and light/dark mode moved into Settings; Appearance is now a top-level menu
fixed: Fixed stale authentication progress still being shown after expiry
Fixed unclear authentication failures; error codes and reasons are now bilingual

added: 新增客户端埋点上报，开发者平台可查看各通道调用量
新增启动器下载站点，统一安装包分发入口
improved: 优化 installer 与启动器载荷同步流程，避免安装包内嵌旧版本程序
优化绿色版（portable）产物，安装包与绿色版同源构建
fixed: 修复安装包内嵌旧版载荷导致的版本不一致问题

added: Added client telemetry reporting for per-channel call statistics
Added the launcher download site as a unified distribution entry
improved: Improved installer payload syncing to avoid stale launcher payloads
Improved the portable build so installer and portable share one source
fixed: Fixed version mismatch caused by stale embedded payloads
